list_directory.desc: List directory contents with sizes and modification times. Best for detailed file listings. Supports recursion and glob filtering. For a visual project structure overview, use directory_tree instead.

params.path: Directory to list. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden entries (names starting with '.'). Default: false
params.max_depth: Max recursion depth when recursive=true. Default: 3
params.glob: Only show files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go, *.{ts,tsx}). Applies to files only — directories are always traversed and shown regardless of glob. Default: all files

create_directory.desc: Create a directory and all missing parents (mkdir -p). No-op if already exists.

delete_directory.desc: Delete a directory. Must be empty unless force=true.

params.force: Delete non-empty directories recursively. Default: false

directory_tree.desc: Show a recursive visual tree of files and directories with sizes. Best for understanding project structure at a glance. For detailed file listings with timestamps, use list_directory instead.

params.glob: Only show files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go). Default: all files
